# KDA Inc.

> > Expert tax preparation, planning, and business advisory services for entrepreneurs, investors, and professionals in Southern California.

KDA Inc. (formerly Karla Dennis and Associates Inc.) is a full-service tax and accounting firm specializing in personalized tax strategies for business owners, real estate investors, medical professionals, and high-income earners in Orange County and Los Angeles. The firm offers comprehensive services from tax preparation and entity formation to cost segregation and IRS audit representation.

## Key Topics

- Tax Planning & Strategy
- Tax Preparation & Filing
- Real Estate Investors
- Business Owners (LLC/S-Corp)
- Cost Segregation
- Entity Formation
- Tax Deductions & Optimization
- Bookkeeping & Payroll
- IRS Audit Representation
- Self-Employed & 1099 Contractors
- Medical Professionals
- Entertainment Industry
- Orange County, California
- Tax Savings
- Premium Advisory Services

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://kdainc.com/services): Main services overview covering tax planning, preparation, bookkeeping, and entity formation
- [Tax Preparation & Filing](https://kdainc.com/services/tax-preparation-filing): Tax preparation and filing for individuals and businesses in Orange County

- [Bookkeeping & Payroll Services](https://kdainc.com/services/bookkeeping-payroll): Full-service bookkeeping and payroll processing for small businesses
- [Entity Formation Services](https://kdainc.com/services/entity-formation): Entity formation services for LLC, S-Corp, and C-Corp business structures
- [Premium Tax Advisory Services](https://kdainc.com/services/premium-advisory-services): Premium tax advisory and strategic planning for business owners and investors

## Specialized Tax Services

- [Real Estate Tax Preparation](https://kdainc.com/services/real-estate-tax-preparation): Specialized tax preparation for rental property owners and real estate investors
- [Cost Segregation Services](https://kdainc.com/services/cost-segregation): Cost segregation and accelerated depreciation strategies for real estate investors
- [Corporate Taxes](https://kdainc.com/services/corporate-taxes): Corporate tax preparation and filing for businesses across Southern California
- [IRS Audit Representation](https://kdainc.com/services/audit-representation): Professional IRS audit representation and tax dispute defense services
